question: where can the GATE's own launcher actually REACH from three of the board's remaining orphan lands, and which objects seal them
instrument: evidence/d682-reach-probe.py -- READ-ONLY.  Builds the same maze3d.Field the gate builds, asks maze3d.pad_escapes (the LATTICE launcher route_join uses) for the land's escapes, and floods maze3d.wave3d from them to exhaustion against a deliberately unreachable goal.  Reports the reached-cell count and bbox per layer and probes named points.  D-672 proved this board's two launchers disagree on U16.3: every corridor verdict taken through maze3d.offcentre_route (which every screen and join_taps drive) is a LAUNCH refusal wearing a corridor's clothes.

authority.verdict: SEALED.  The wavefront never leaves the pad: 66 cells in a 1.55 x 0.15 mm slot that is U16.3's own footprint strip, and ZERO cells on F.Cu or In2.Cu.

with_the_channel_cleared.verdict: the land OPENS -- 57 679 cells on three layers, and it can go NORTH freely to y = 41.75 -- and it still cannot reach its own net.  Every one of its own copper points lies SOUTH of y = 60.3 and the wavefront stops at y = 55.5 (F), 57.05 (B) and 60.0 (In2).

the_three_southern_seals.B.Cu: the passive row at y = 57.735 (R50/R63/R129/R102).  Its widest gap, x 57.800..58.650 between R129's two lands, is sealed by the +3V3 0.70/0.40 mm BARREL at (57.900, 57.400) and its two 0.400 mm stubs -- which are R129.1's ONLY bond to the 3.3 V rail, the land D-606..D-632 spent twenty-six decisions on.  The next gap west is WAKE_GATE_S's own hub to R63.2, the next east is TCA4307_READY.
the_three_southern_seals.In2.Cu: /ACC_3V3_SW -- PROTECTED COPPER -- forms a closed wedge: a 0.400 mm bar (57.400,60.650) -> (59.975,60.425) with a 0.900 mm barrel at EACH end, plus the two 0.400 mm diagonals that meet at (59.975,60.425).  Union of barrel and track keep-outs spans x 56.95..60.425 at y ~ 60.4-60.65.  It cannot be moved.
the_three_southern_seals.F.Cu: /ACC_3V3_SW (53.775,51.400) -> (71.275,69.625) at 0.400 mm and /ACC_5V_SW_EN (53.750,52.500) -> (66.000,71.250) at 0.200 mm -- BOTH PROTECTED -- cross the whole south-west quadrant of the reachable region.

i2c_scl_int_u16_3.ruling: U16.3 is walled on ALL THREE of its permitted layers and on TWO of them by PROTECTED copper.  D-671 sec 7(2)'s 'U16 / R17 / R63 pocket refloorplan' is REFUTED in its stated form: no rip-up bounded by that pocket reaches the net, because the wall is the passive farm at y 57.7-61.4 and the protected ACC_3V3_SW wedge BELOW it, not the pocket.  The only remaining lever is moving U16 itself SOUTH of the farm, into the y 62-67 highway -- a transaction that releases all EIGHT of its escapes and sweeps BAT_PROTECTED_P's 1.000 mm trunk at x = 62.2.  Not attempted here; PRICED.

rungs.1 (0.200 run, 0.65 barrel): NO_VIA_SITE within 15.0 mm of any escape
rungs.3 (0.200 run, 0.35 barrel): NO_VIA_SITE within 15.0 mm of any escape

plus3v3_u5_2.ruling: the search radius was DOUBLED from D-647's 8 mm to 15 mm and the smallest barrel this board licenses outright was already on the ladder, so 'no via site' is not a radius artefact and not a barrel-size artefact.  U5.2 is a DIFFERENT wall from U4.5's and the instrument that just closed U4.5 does not reach it.

acc_5v_lx_topology.finding: the TPS61023's east column is GND(4) / SW(5) / VOUT(6) in that order, so ANY approach to the switch node from the north crosses U21.4's land -- the switch node can only be entered from the EAST.  U21.4's own ground escape is the B.Cu chain (58.700,39.375) -> (60.600,38.425) -> (60.925,38.250) -> (61.100,38.000) -> (63.000,38.100), which also leaves east.  At x = 58.7 the LX lane sits at y = 39.46 and the GND chain at y = 39.375: they cross 0.085 mm apart.  THE CROSSING IS THE PINOUT, NOT THE PLACEMENT.
acc_5v_lx_topology.why_moving_L4_does_not_fix_it: L4 west by 1.572 mm would put L4.2 directly above U21.5 -- and apply_part_shift REFUSES it: L4.1's land would swallow the 0.900 mm /ACC_5V_RAW barrel at (55.850,38.000) and the 0.600 mm /ACC_5V_FB barrel at (56.100,36.900).  The move is bounded to about 0.8 mm west, which does not reach U21.5's column -- and would not help if it did, because of the pinout.
acc_5v_lx_topology.the_only_non_crossing_route: U21.4's ground out the WEST through U21's own 0.750 mm inter-column channel.  At the 0.300 mm GND width with 0.200 mm clearance that channel leaves a 0.050 mm centre-line window (57.775 .. 57.825), and D-681 already proved the channel's current tenant, /ACC_DETECT_N, relays out of it in 5.866 mm with zero vias.  The open question is therefore a GND WIDTH question in a named 0.750 mm channel, not a placement search.
acc_5v_lx_topology.no_local_sys_copper: /01_POWER_TREE/BQ25185_SYS owns NO tracks at all near U21: L4.1 and U21.3 are one island because `B /01_POWER_TREE/BQ25185_SYS POUR 2` (55.0,33.0)-(60.0,42.0), 10.813 mm2 filled, holds both.  A part move in this cell therefore strands no SYS conductor -- the pour refills.
